history.dynasty: Namgyal dynasty (Sikkimese monarchy); the 16th Karmapa later made this his temporary seat
history.period: Early modern - CONFLICT: founded 1734 by the fourth Chogyal Gyurmed Namgyal (official Sikkim ECCL history) vs mid-18th century under the 12th Karmapa Changchub Dorje (Wikipedia) vs 1730 (weaker secondary sources)
history.summary: THIS IS A BUDDHIST MONASTERY (KARMA KAGYU TIBETAN BUDDHISM) - NOT A HINDU TEMPLE; keep-or-drop decision needed. Old Rumtek Gonpa, religious name 'Karma Thubten Chokhorling', is the ORIGINAL Rumtek monastery, standing about half a kilometre from the present-day Rumtek Dharma Chakra Centre. The official Sikkim ECCL history says it was founded in 1734 by the fourth Chogyal Gyurmed Namgyal and was one of the major Kagyupa monasteries of East Sikkim; Wikipedia instead attributes the original Rumtek to the 12th Karmapa Changchub Dorje in the mid-18th century (founding-attribution conflict - verify). When the 16th Karmapa, Rangjung Rigpe Dorje, arrived in Sikkim in 1959 after fleeing Tibet, he made his seat in this Old Rumtek Gonpa for some years while the new Dharma Chakra Centre was built nearby; the old structure was later dismantled and a new building constructed with government funding. Lama dances are performed here on the 28th and 29th days of the 10th Tibetan month before Losoong. MEDIA NOTE: no reliable image of the old gonpa itself could be found (image searches returned only the new monastery complex), so media is left empty rather than mislabelled.

name: Old Rumtek Monastery
town: Rumtek (~24 km from Gangtok; ~0.5 km from the new Rumtek Dharma Chakra Centre)
town_description: Rumtek is a hilltop settlement about 24 km from Gangtok in Gangtok district (East Sikkim), at ~1,500 m altitude. The old gonpa stands a short distance (about half a kilometre) from the grand new Dharma Chakra Centre on the same hillside, in a quieter, more meditative setting with views across the valley towards Gangtok.
tradition: Buddhism (Tibetan, Karma Kagyu) - NOT a Hindu temple

travel.airport: Nearest airport is Bagdogra (IXB), approx. 124-160 km (verify); Pakyong Airport is closer but has limited flights.
travel.railway: Nearest major railway station is New Jalpaiguri (NJP), approx. 125-150 km (verify).
travel.road: About 24 km from Gangtok by road (Ranipool-Rumtek-Sang road); the old gonpa is a short walk or drive from the main Rumtek monastery complex.

visitor_information.best_time: March to June or September to November; the 10th Tibetan month for the pre-Losoong lama dances (dates follow the Tibetan calendar).
visitor_information.opening_hours: An official Sikkim place listing gives 8:00 AM - 3:00 PM daily (verify locally - the old gonpa is much less visited than the main monastery).
